title: Use Every AI Model in One Place (LLM Router Setup)
description:
Run every AI model from one place. In this quick guide I show how to set up an LLM router so ChatGPT, Claude, and Codex all work together instead of living in separate tabs. The key is OpenRouter, a tool that plugs into every major AI API, so when one model gets stuck or hits a limit, your setup automatically routes the request to another one.

You don't need to be a coder. You ask Claude to build the router, connect OpenRouter, and plug it in. That's the whole AI workflow. One setup, every model, zero tab switching.

Get the free LLM Router setup guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1FmJ9GuwiFf5InoCjg5FW3M70mGkzt1bB0rglHWYEDN0/edit?usp=sharing

#AI #LLM #OpenRouter #ChatGPT #Claude #AItools #ClaudeCode
